topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I just found out that Alex has been spinning a tale about their job for months. I mean, who does that? I heard from a mutual friend that Alex's supposed high-flying career in tech is actually... a struggle at a small startup that’s barely staying afloat. It’s hard to process. I never pegged Alex as someone who would pretend to be something they’re not. I keep thinking back to all those times we had drinks and they wove these intricate stories about their busy life and the fancy clients. Now I’m left wondering, what else was never real?
